description: Future manuscript figures only. This catalog is a routing contract, not evidence that new experiments have run. Old hybrid PDFs and numerical results are not accepted.

figures.label: fig:overview
figures.purpose: Pure schematic of LLM policies, language delivery, trading, and shared observations. No empirical curves, fitted exponents, threshold values, or claims about their direction.

figures.label: fig:nonlinear-response
figures.purpose: Observed primary collapse probability versus harmful participation. Only completed, verified real full-LLM main runs.

figures.label: fig:finite-size
figures.purpose: Resolved collapse boundaries and corresponding harmful counts across population sizes, with unresolved cases retained explicitly. Only completed, verified real full-LLM main runs.

figures.label: fig:intervention
figures.purpose: Paired intervention effects on the collapse boundary. Only completed, verified real full-LLM main runs; censored boundaries must not be invented.

exclusions: All PDFs generated by paper_experiments_v3 or legacy_experiments
Any mock, smoke, pilot, incomplete, rule-only or hybrid result
fig3_finite_size_scaling_horizontal.pdf (not referenced by the final main/supplement)
Uncatalogued figures, even if present in the paper's Figures directory
